name: VVV CL001 (Hubble)
blurb: VVV CL001, a globular cluster toward the Galactic bulge, seen by Hubble.
label: vvvcl001-hubble
story: A low-mass globular cluster hidden behind thick interstellar dust toward the Milky Way's bulge, likely the most metal-poor surviving globular cluster in the inner Galaxy. It lies next to another cluster, UKS 1, and the two may be a true cluster pair.

claims.text: VVV CL001 is a globular cluster toward the Galactic bulge in a region of high interstellar reddening
VVV CL001 is likely the most metal-poor surviving globular cluster in the inner Galaxy
VVV CL001 is a low-mass globular cluster next to UKS 1; the two are candidates for a physical cluster binary
VVV-CL001 is one of the heavily extincted bulge globular clusters imaged by the Hubble Missing Globular Clusters Survey
